units.title: SG-2.4 Manifest loader checks references and falls back without crashing
Act: Add checkAssetRefs to the manifest loader
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Added exported checkAssetRefs(manifest, refs) to game/src/assets/loaders/manifestLoader.ts, matching the brief's snippet, at end of file (the file is 31 lines, not 33, so 'after L33' became 'at end'). Another change landed in the same file during the run, adding loadManifestWithFallback and an AssetEntry import; I left it untouched and kept checkAssetRefs. The expected 'npx tsc --noEmit passes' is not met: it exits with 33 errors, the same count as a clean HEAD checkout. None are in checkAssetRefs. They come from a missing @types/node (tsconfig has types: [], so node:fs/node:path are unresolved) and pre-existing test files (config.test.ts, content.test.ts, persistence.test.ts). Fixing that is outside this unit. I ran npm ci in game/ to get node_modules (gitignored). Nothing committed. Tests not run.
